text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Former finance director for the Preferential Trade Area (PTA), Jotham Kotamo, plans to sue the COMESA bank for unfair dismissal, after he exposed alleged irregularities and mismanagement in the institution.
- Police have detained a 33-year-old woman for allegedly masterminding the killing of a pregnant woman in central Malawi.

- Prosecutor Kamudoni Nyasulu's decision to hire two British lawyers to review the three-year backlog of more than 1,000 homicides, has angered local lawyers accusing him of offering jobs to foreigners.
- President Bakili Muluzi has appointed publisher of the defunct Tribute newspaper, Din Balakasi, to represent Malawi as second secretary at the United Nations.
